antidote_vessel.description: Clears poison and wither once every ten seconds.

bunny_hoppers.description: Higher jumps, five extra safe-fall blocks and half fall damage.

charm_of_shrinking.description: Shrinks the wearer to half size.

charm_of_sinking.description: Sink toward the bottom underwater; adds oxygen reserve.

cross_necklace.description: Extends the brief invulnerability after taking a hit.

digging_claws.description: Doubles block-breaking speed; your tool still determines harvest eligibility.

eternal_steak.description: Reusable food. One-minute cooldown after eating.

everlasting_beef.description: Reusable food. One-minute cooldown after eating.

fire_gauntlet.description: Melee hits ignite permitted targets for four seconds.

flame_pendant.description: Ignites permitted melee attackers for four seconds. Five-second cooldown.

night_vision_goggles.description: Night vision while worn; fades within twelve seconds after removal.

obsidian_skull.description: After fire hurts you, grants ten seconds of fire resistance. Thirty-second cooldown.

panic_necklace.description: Taking damage grants Speed II for five seconds. Ten-second cooldown.

rooted_boots.description: Standing still on grass restores one food every ten seconds.

running_shoes.description: Twenty-five percent faster sprinting and one-block step height.

scarf_of_invisibility.description: Invisibility while worn; armor remains visible.

shock_pendant.description: Resists lightning and shocks permitted melee attackers for 3 damage. Five-second cooldown.

thorn_pendant.description: Returns 2 damage to permitted melee attackers. Three-second cooldown.

universal_attractor.description: Draws nearby loose items toward you. Respects claims and pickup ownership.

vampiric_glove.description: Melee hits heal 20% of damage, at most one heart per second.

withered_bracelet.description: Melee hits inflict Wither for three seconds. Five-second cooldown.
